purpose: Teach: 西郷/母性/強まる/デリケート/青く/突っ込む/打ち込む/兼ね備え

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、明治維新の、本気で、絶対、西郷、絶対、隆盛、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, your paper on Saigo Takamori during the Meiji Restoration was genuinely impressive. I was really struck by it.
lines.style: Warm, genuine praise. Steady eye contact. Slight lean forward to show engagement. Unhurried pacing—the words land because they're not rushed. A teacher speaking to a student she respects.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。古代の、本気で、絶対、母性、絶対、観、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I spent a lot of time exploring the concept of motherhood in ancient thought, and I'm grateful for the chance to have presented it.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude, genuine but slightly formal. Respectful distance maintained. Steady voice without false modesty. The tone of someone who means what they're saying and knows how to say it properly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国際情勢が、本気で、絶対、強まる、絶対、緊張、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And the way you connected it to shifts in international relations—you had such a broad perspective. It showed real depth of thinking.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective pace. Slight pause before the last sentence to let the observation land. Encouraging without being patronizing. The voice of someone genuinely engaging with a student's ideas.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。古典芸能の、本気で、絶対、デリケート、絶対、な表現、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes—I tried to handle the more delicate aspects of classical performance traditions with the care they deserved.
lines.style: Modest but assured. No apology in the voice. Speaking as a student who did the work and knows it. Respectful tone maintained, but without deferring on the substance of what was done.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 夜空が、本気で、絶対、青く、絶対、染まる、絶対、瞬間、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The moment you described—when the night sky takes on that blue at dusk—you really made that come alive in your analysis. That kind of specificity was striking.
lines.style: Genuinely engaged, almost surprised by her own observation. Slower pace on 'that blue at dusk'—she's remembering it. Warmth in the voice, the approval of a teacher who sees a student thinking clearly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史上の、本気で、絶対、市場に、絶対、突っ込む、絶対、決断、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to show how decisive moments in history—even the risky ones, the market entries—came from a kind of courage worth examining.
lines.style: Earnest, thinking aloud slightly. Not defensive, but explaining the choice. The voice of someone who chose their focus deliberately and wants to be understood. Calm and clear.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 伝統技能に、本気で、絶対、打ち込む、絶対、職人の姿、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: What impressed me most was how you portrayed the artisans—the people devoted to traditional crafts. You really captured something true about them.
lines.style: Reflective, almost quiet with appreciation. The words come with care. Speaking as though she's realizing it as she says it. The cadence of a teacher who sees beyond the paper to what the student understands.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。複数の才を、本気で、絶対、兼ね備えた、絶対、人物像、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: I wanted to show that these were people of real complexity—people with multiple gifts, not just one skill. Thank you for reading it so thoughtfully.
lines.style: Soft gratitude. The final word 'thoughtfully' trails slightly—genuine relief that the work was understood. Quiet dignity. The close of a good exchange.
